name: Spagetti za predelami ramok privychnoj real'nosti
original_name: Спагетти за пределами рамок привычной реальности
source: The last remaining factory processes all the evil emitted by the STAR into strange and new forms. The only problem is that working at such a factory is boring, mind-numbing, and annoying. I feel like I should talk to the Boss about this. And the manager. And the coworkers. And the cook. And the mathematician. Basically, with any person. Any living creature? I am not sure if rats count as living creatures, but it would not be a bad idea to talk to them too...
